stats.note: Torah LM2/48 has zero bechina edges in the dataset (all three edges with reference 1048 in torahData.js are type 'eitza'). There is therefore no bechina subgraph to process and no packages can be formed from the dataset. The source text (torah_48.txt) does contain two bechina-type equations — הִתְרַחֲקוּת הוּא הִתְקָרְבוּת and עַצְבוּת הִיא סִטְרָא אָחֳרָא — but neither has been entered into the dataset. These are documented in the additions file.
